pages: This guide documents the materials and equipment produced through elemental smithing. It covers steel and its derivative alloys, the three crystal types, knight armor, and the three elemental swords.
Each entry below describes the material's properties, its relative strengths and drawbacks, and its intended use.

Steel is the base crafting material for tools and weapons. It is durable and inexpensive (but labor-intensive) to produce, but more brittle than higher-tier alloys and can fail under sustained heavy use.
Steel is best suited for early-game tools and weapons, and serves as the base component for higher-tier alloys such as Damask Steel.

Damask Steel is produced by repeatedly folding steel during forging. This process increases both strength and flexibility relative to plain steel, giving it greater resistance to breaking under strain.
Damask Steel equipment offers a balance of durability and handling, making it well suited for regular combat use.

Reinforced Damask Steel is a heavier, higher-tier alloy. It provides the highest durability and cutting performance of any steel-based material, and is capable of piercing armor that lesser materials cannot.
Its increased weight raises crafting difficulty and reduces handling speed. This trade-off is generally offset by its superior durability and damage output.
Blessed Crystal is a luminous material with holy-aligned properties. Tools crafted from it do not lose their edge over time, making them effectively immune to wear.
Blessed Crystal is fragile relative to metal alloys. It should be handled with care during use.
Cursed Crystal is a material formed from gems and rotten flesh.
Exercise caution when crafting or wielding Cursed Crystal equipment, as its power is offset by unpredictable side effects (WIP).
Pure Crystal is a refined, high-clarity material valued for its balance of strength and precision. It is end-game resource.
Pure Crystal tools, provide a notable bonus to yield and efficiency on suitable tasks.
Knight Armor is a steel-based armor set that provides reliable, general-purpose protection.
Each piece contributes to overall defense and is suited to standard combat scenarios.
Reinforced Knight Armor is crafted from Reinforced Damask Steel and provides the highest defense of any armor set in this line.
Its added weight reduces mobility, but it grants superior protection against most forms of damage.

pages.text: • The Legend of the Frost Sword

pages: The Frost Sword is crafted by combining steel with a Frost Core. It applies ice-based effects on hit, including slowing and freezing struck targets.
Its control effects make it useful for managing enemy positioning during combat.

pages.text: • The Legend of the Flame Sword

pages: The Flame Sword is crafted by combining steel with a Flame Core. It applies fire-based effects on hit, igniting struck targets.
Its ignite effect makes it useful for applying damage over time during combat.

pages.text: • The Legend of the Amorphous Sword

pages: The Amorphous Sword combines the Flame Sword, the Frost Sword, and a Soul Core into a single weapon.
It grants access to both fire- and ice-based effects, and represents the highest tier of weapon in this progression.
Crafting it requires first obtaining all prerequisite materials described elsewhere in this guide.
This concludes the overview of materials and equipment covered in this guide. Refer to each section above for further detail on crafting requirements and recommended uses.
